messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Metering alert: sudden token delta spike detected (eu-west-1). metric=billing.token_delta rate=+18% window=03:02-03:07 trace=tx-9a3f
Samir (oncall): ack
Samir (oncall): paging oncall, grabbing runbook -> /runbooks/metering-token-drifts
Samir (oncall): @Priya can you confirm whether overage flags fired?
Priya (billing): checking now, running quick query against shadow ledger
Priya (billing): ```sql
select sum(delta) as extra, count(distinct customer_id) as customers
from billing.shadow_delta
where ts between '2025-08-12T03:02:00Z' and '2025-08-12T03:07:00Z';
-- result: extra=1,142,601 tokens, customers=7
```
Priya (billing): 7 customers show anomalous spikes, most in EU. Affected customers: cust_42, cust_91, cust_108...
Alex (platform): kafka consumer cg-meter-01 shows lag jump, partitions p-3/p-4 stuck at ~140k msgs. tail of logs shows repeated emitter retries.
Alex (platform): log snippet: `emitter/retry.go:87 WARN retrying event id=ev-33 status=500 attempts=6`
Samir (oncall): likely duplicate emission + delayed ack windowing. Mitigation step 1: pause emitter retry loop for eu-west topic. Executing: `kubectl set env deploy/emitter EMITTER_RETRY=0 -n prod-eu`
ops-bot: deploy patch applied to emitter/eu-west (rev=emitter-20250812-03-12)
Samir (oncall): Mitigation step 2: enable short-term ingest-throttle at ingress proxy to 60% to reduce pressure. Command: `proxyctl throttle set /ingest 0.6 --reason "mitigation token surge"`
Priya (billing): temporarily suppressing automated overage alerts for the 7 impacted customers to avoid noise. Will mark alerts as suppressed in PagerDuty for the window.
finance-ops: noted — hold off billing adjustments until reconciliation complete. We need detailed deltas.
Samir (oncall): customer impact summary for now: no billed overcharges yet (alerts suppressed), small subset had provisional overage flags; live usage reporting delayed by ~4-6 mins. We'll reconcile final counts after backfill.
Alex (platform): starting backfill consumer to replay missing commits with idempotency check. Rolling it out with canary=2 pods.
Priya (billing): quick reconcile query template: `insert into billing.reconciles (cust,delta,source) select customer_id, sum(delta), 'post-incident' from billing.shadow_delta where ts >= '2025-08-12T03:02:00Z' group by customer_id;`
Samir (oncall): ETA for stabilization ~20-30m if backfill proceeds. Monitoring: `kafka.consumer_lag`, `billing.shadow_delta`, `emit.retry.rate`, `billing.alerts.suppressed`
Lee (night oncall): I can take over at T+25m, please leave handoff note with what to watch.
Samir (oncall): handoff checklist -> 1) confirm consumer lag trending down (goal <5k), 2) confirm backfill job progress and idempotency logs, 3) verify suppressed alerts still suppressed and do not auto-unmute until reconciliation done, 4) run reconcile query and post results to #incidents.
Priya (billing): I'll prepare reconciliation CSV and post to S3 `s3://redwood-incidents/reconciles/2025-08-12-03-07.csv` once done.
Samir (oncall): leaving handoff to Lee in 10m. Final note: do not re-enable emitter retries until backfill completed. If lag persists >45m escalate to platform infra. :thumbsup:
Lee (night oncall): taking over in 10. thanks all.
incidents-bot: Incident note created: INC-2025-0812-01, severity=medium, status=mitigating, owners=[Samir,Priya,Alex], link=https://redwood.incidents/INC-2025-0812-01
Samir (oncall): closing active pager. handoff to Lee for recon and postmortem inputs. :white_check_mark:
